audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating 7.5/10 against a 56.88% Gangplank win rate over 1025 games.
audit.why: This is one of Gangplank's better lanes: a brutal three levels followed by a scaling curve Renekton cannot answer. The difficulty is the survival window, not the lane.
audit.corrected: Difficulty 5/10 — survive to 4, then it is yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart said 'Skill' at level 1 while the early text says 'Levels 1-3 are his, full stop', and gave Renekton the first-item and 2-item stages while whys[5] and whys[6] say those are exactly where you burst him and he 'has no sustained damage left'.
audit.why: Renekton's Fury combo bullies a keg-less Gangplank through 3; from level 4-5 Parrrley-detonated kegs out-range him and the Sheen spike lands as his bully phase ends.
audit.corrected: One group: L1 Renekton 3/10, L2 Renekton 3/10, L3 Skill 5/10, L4-5 Gangplank 7/10, L6 Skill 5/10, First item Gangplank 8/10, 2+ items Gangplank 9/10.
sources: currentText.early, whys[2], whys[3], whys[4], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry tells you to save Remove Scurvy for the stun 'not his Q slow' — Renekton's Q has no slow, and his kit has no slow at all. Ruthless Predator's stun durations, its auto-attack reset, and its empowered shield-destruction are all missing, as is the fact that Cull the Meek heals him.
audit.why: Riot text: Q 'deals moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt' — no slow, and it heals off every minion in the wave, which is why anti-heal is core. W: 'stuns them for 0.75 seconds... If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes three times, destroying damage shields on the target... stunning them for 1.5 seconds', 16/14/12/10/8, and it carries the autoReset flag so the attack wind-up is the tell. E Slice and Dice is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10 and its empowered version shreds armour.
audit.corrected: The phantom Q slow removed; stun durations, the 16s cooldown, the auto-reset tell and the shield destruction stated; Cull the Meek's wave healing tied to buying Oblivion Orb.

audit.why: report[8] already prescribes Oblivion Orb / Executioner's early; the content layer just never explained why, which the mid rewrite now does.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ruthless Predator and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by surviving levels 1-3 and by tracking his 16s Ruthless Predator.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Renekton carry threat 7/10.

- Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Respect it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (16s at rank 1): matchup-defining — 0.75s base, 1.5s at 50+ Fury, and an auto reset. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Empowered = long stun. Respect it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 0.75s base stun, 1.5s at 50+ Fury. Engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Respect it. When it is down — Barrel-Q + R him.
edits.after: Track Ruthless Predator (16s): 1.5s stun at 50+ Fury and an auto reset. When down — Barrel-Q + R him.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The empowered version also destroys shields before it lands.

edits.before: Hold W (Remove Scurvy) for his empowered-W stun, not his Q slow, and heal back the chip from his dash-in combo
edits.after: Hold W (Remove Scurvy) for his 1.5s empowered-W stun, then heal back the chip from his dash-in combo

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his, full stop — I have no real waveclear, my single keg has a long early cooldown and low HP that he just free-hits off the wall, and his empowered W (Ruthless Predator) stun plus his Slice-and-Dice dash let him point-click chunk me every time I step up to last-hit. Don't try to trade here; place the keg tight to the wave so he can't pop it for free, take only the CS I can reach safely, and hold W (Remove Scurvy) for the empowered-W stun, not his Q slow. Accept I'm a bit behind on the map and just don't feed his fury bar.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his, full stop — I have no real waveclear, my single keg has a long early cooldown and low HP that he just free-hits off the wall, and his empowered W (Ruthless Predator) stun plus his Slice-and-Dice dash let him point-click chunk me every time I step up to last-hit. Don't try to trade here; place the keg tight to the wave so he can't pop it for free, take only the CS I can reach safely, and hold W (Remove Scurvy) for the 1.5s empowered stun — his W is an auto reset, so the swing is the tell, not the cast. Don't feed his fury bar.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are where I climb out: second points in Q and E mean I can Parrrley-detonate a keg from range, so now Renekton has to walk into barrel poke just to farm. At 6 my Cannon Barrage adds zone and dive pressure but doesn't win the raw duel into a full fury bar, so 6 is roughly even — don't all-in him while his W and dash are up. Bait the Slice-and-Dice and the stun, W-cleanse it, then detonate the keg chain while he's stuck committed.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are where I climb out: second points in Q and E mean I can Parrrley-detonate a keg from range, so now Renekton has to walk into barrel poke just to farm. At 6 my Cannon Barrage adds zone and dive pressure but doesn't win the raw duel into a full fury bar, so 6 is roughly even — don't all-in him while his W and dash are up. Bait the dash, cleanse the stun, then detonate the chain — and buy Oblivion Orb, since Cull the Meek heals him off the wave.

notes: The entry told the player to save Remove Scurvy for the stun 'not his Q slow' — Renekton has no slow anywhere in his kit, so that instruction pointed at nothing. dosFull[2].t reads 'Q-cleanse his slows' (19 chars, under the applier's 25-char skip threshold) and needs the same manual fix seen on poppy and quinn: the cleanse is Remove Scurvy (W), and there is no slow to cleanse here.
